narrative.intro: Mistral’s federal contracting activity in FY2026 to date centers on $213M in obligations across 9 awards and an average award size of $23.7M. Obligations are up 384.3% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $213M, while the Department of Justice accounts for $7.4K. The largest NAICS market is Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $191M, followed by Aircraft Manufacturing at $22.5M. Historical obligations before FY2026 include $224K in FY21, $39.4K in FY22, $727K in FY24, and $44M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. The data show a concentration of spending in a small number of large awards and in a narrow set of markets. Companies analyzing Mistral for teaming or subcontracting should factor the buyer concentration and the handful of large awards when planning outreach or capability positioning.

sections.heading: Who are Mistral’s main federal buyers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $213M. The Department of Justice obligated $7.4K. No other agencies are listed among the top buyers in the provided data.

sections.heading: What markets and award patterns define Mistral’s contracts?
sections.body: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing is the largest market at $191M. Aircraft Manufacturing is the second market at $22.5M. Mistral has 9 awards with an average award size of $23.7M, and obligations are up 384.3% year over year.

faq.q: How much does Mistral make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Mistral has total federal contract obligations of $213M in FY2026 to date. Mistral has 9 awards and an average award size of $23.7M. Historical obligations include $224K in FY21, $39.4K in FY22, $727K in FY24, and $44M in FY25.
The Department of Defense is the primary buyer, obligating $213M. The Department of Justice is a much smaller buyer, obligating $7.4K.

faq.q: What does Mistral sell to the government?
faq.a: Mistral sells primarily in Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $191M and in Aircraft Manufacturing at $22.5M. Smaller markets include Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K.
